item.title: CV
item.description:
Research Summary

Computational cognitive science researcher focused on cognitive control, working memory, learning, and adaptive behavior in human cognition. My work combines trial-level behavioral analysis, statistical modeling, and reproducible Python- and R-based workflows to study interference, decision processes, and individual differences.

Education

Bachelor of Psychology, Islamic Azad University, Tehran, Iran
2021–2025

GPA: 19.55/20 (approximately 3.9/4.0)

Thesis: Relationship Between Psychological Disorders and Defense Mechanisms in Adolescents
Supervisor: Dr. Hamid Reza Vatankhah
